predecessors.name: Delian League
predecessors.text: the Chalcidic peninsula (Chalcidice) with Olynthus at its head

successors.name: Kingdom of Macedon
successors.text: the Chalcidic peninsula (Chalcidice) with Olynthus at its head

ledger.x: 432: Olynthus becomes the head of the Chalcidian League.
393/2: Amyntas III cedes territory to Olynthos.
391: Amyntas III takes back the land he gave in 393/2.
385: Amyntas III cedes land, including Pella, to the whole League.
By 382: the League absorbs most Greek cities west of the Strymon.
ledger.cp: Greek cities west of the Strymon

ledger.x: 379: the cities outside the Chalcidic peninsula are freed.
379: Pella leaves the League with its dissolution.
379: the former League's cities become 'autonomous' and 'subject allies of Sparta'.
375: the Chalcidians revolt and re-found the League.
348: Philip II destroys Olynthus and the League.

wars.name: Spartan war against the Chalcidian League
wars.outcome: 'After three years of indecisive warfare Olynthus consented to dissolve the confederacy in 379'; the cities became subject allies of Sparta.

wars.name: Philip II's capture of Olynthus
wars.outcome: 'The siege was short'; Philip bought two citizens who betrayed the city, razed it and sold its population into slavery.

certainty.note: No page gives any frontier of the League; membership is a list of cities (32 or 34 at the peak), not a bounded territory.
